items.source: properties - the properties
items.translation: properties - 属性

items.source: Default is false, meaning that external entities are not resolved. Note that processing of external entities will only be enabled/disabled when the Source passed to unmarshal(Source) is a SAXSource or StreamSource. It has no effect for DOMSource or StAXSource instances.
items.translation: 默认值为 `false`，表示不解析外部实体。请注意，只有在传递给 unmarshal(Source) 的Source是SAXSource或StreamSource时，才会启用/禁用外部实体的处理。对于DOMSource或StAXSource实例，此设置无效。

items.source: The default implementation sets the defined properties, the validation event handler, the schemas, listener, and adapters.
items.translation: 默认实现会设置定义的属性、验证事件处理器、模式、监听器以及适配器。

items.source: The default implementation sets the defined properties, the validation event handler, the schemas, listener, and adapters.
items.translation: 默认实现会设置定义的属性、验证事件处理器、模式、监听器以及适配器。

items.source: Default is false, meaning that supports(Class) always returns false for JAXBElement classes (though supports(Type) can return true, since it can obtain the type parameters of JAXBElement).
items.translation: 默认值为 `false`，这意味着对于 `JAXBElement` 类，`supports(Class)` 始终返回 `false`（尽管 `supports(Type)` 可能返回 `true`，因为它可以获取 `JAXBElement` 的类型参数）。

items.source: Note: setting this option to true also automatically sets setSupportDtd(boolean) to true.
items.translation: 注意： 将此选项设置为 true 也会自动将 setSupportDtd(boolean) 设置为 true。

items.source: Setting either this property, "classesToBeBound" or "packagesToScan" is required.
items.translation: 设置此属性、"classesToBeBound" 或 "packagesToScan" 其中之一是必需的。

items.source: Setting either this property, "contextPath" or "packagesToScan" is required.
items.translation: 设置此属性、"contextPath" 或 "packagesToScan" 是必需的。

items.source: Setting either this property, "contextPath" or "classesToBeBound" is required.
items.translation: 设置此属性、"contextPath" 或 "classesToBeBound" 是必需的。

items.source: This property is typically enabled in combination with usage of classes like MarshallingView, since the ModelAndView does not offer type parameter information at runtime.
items.translation: 此属性通常与使用诸如MarshallingView之类的类一起启用，因为ModelAndView在运行时不提供类型参数信息。

items.source: Default is true, meaning that supports(Class) will check for this annotation. However, some JAXB implementations (i.e. EclipseLink MOXy) allow for defining the bindings in an external definition file, thus keeping the classes annotations free. Setting this property to false supports these JAXB implementations.
items.translation: 默认值为 `true`，这意味着 `supports(Class)` 将检查此注解。然而，某些 JAXB 实现（即 EclipseLink MOXy）允许在外部定义文件中定义绑定，从而保持类注解为空。将此属性设置为 `false` 可支持这些 JAXB 实现。

items.source: Early initialization just applies if afterPropertiesSet() is called.
items.translation: 早期初始化仅在调用afterPropertiesSet()时生效。

items.source: These properties will be set on the underlying JAXB Marshaller, and allow for features such as indentation.
items.translation: 这些属性将设置在下层 JAXB `<code>Marshaller` 上，并允许诸如缩进等功能。

items.source: These properties will be set on the underlying JAXB Unmarshaller.
items.translation: 这些属性将设置在下方的 JAXB Unmarshaller 上。

items.source:
The typical usage will be to set either the "contextPath" or the "classesToBeBound"
property on this bean, possibly customize the marshaller and unmarshaller by setting
properties, schemas, adapters, and listeners, and to refer to it.
items.translation: 典型用法是在此 Bean 上设置"contextPath"或"classesToBeBound"属性，通过设置属性、模式（schemas）、适配器和监听器来自定义序列化器和反序列化器，然后引用该 Bean。

items.source:
Note: JAXB marshallers are not necessarily thread-safe.
This method is public as of 5.2.
items.translation: 注意：JAXB 序列化器不一定线程安全。此方法自 5.2 版本起为 public。

items.source:
Note: JAXB unmarshallers are not necessarily thread-safe.
This method is public as of 5.2.
items.translation: 注意：JAXB 反序列化器不一定线程安全。此方法自 5.2 版本起为 public。

items.source: Marshals the object graph with the given root into the provided Result, writing binary data to a MimeContainer.
items.translation: 将具有给定根的对象图marshalling到提供的Result中，并将二进制数据写入MimeContainer。

items.source: Specify whether the supports(Class) returns true for the JAXBElement class.
items.translation: 指定 supports(Class) 是否对 JAXBElement 类返回 true。

items.source: Unmarshals the given provided Source into an object graph, reading binary attachments from a MimeContainer.
items.translation: 将给定的 `Source` 反序列化为对象图，并从 `MimeContainer` 读取二进制附件。

items.source: Specify the XmlAdapters to be registered with the JAXB Marshaller and Unmarshaller.
items.translation: 指定要注册到 JAXB Marshaller 和 Unmarshaller 的 XmlAdapter。

items.source: Specify whether the supports(Class) should check for @XmlRootElement annotations.
items.translation: 指定是否应检查 `supports(Class)` 是否存在`@XmlRootElement` 注解。

items.source: Set the schema language. Default is the W3C XML Schema: http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema".
items.translation: 设置模式语言。默认值为 W3C XML 模式：http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema。

items.source: Specify whether MTOM support should be enabled or not. Default is false: marshalling using XOP/MTOM not being enabled.
items.translation: 指定是否启用 MTOM 支持。默认为 `false`：不启用使用 XOP/MTOM 的序列化。

items.source: Logger available to subclasses.
items.translation: 可供子类使用的 Logger。

items.translation: 指示该转换器是否可以序列化所供应类型的实例。

items.source:
Set multiple JAXB context paths. The given array of context paths gets
converted to a colon-delimited string, as supported by JAXB.
items.translation: 设置多个 JAXB 上下文路径。给定的上下文路径数组将转换为 JAXB 支持的冒号分隔字符串。

items.source:
Set the JAXB validation event handler. This event handler will be called by JAXB
if any validation errors are encountered during calls to any of the marshal APIs.
items.translation: 设置 JAXB 验证事件处理器。如果在调用任何编组 API 期间遇到任何验证错误，JAXB 将调用此事件处理器。
